_why_warmup: 2,100 is a FLOOR, not a taste: the previous-week level cannot exist before a full week of bars has closed (2,016 at 5m), and comparing it inside that week reports a warm-up as a defect. Inside the warm-up the gate feeds the export's own day/week levels, because a real run has history before its window and this export is a slice — the derived values are still computed and compared on every bar after it.
_what_it_ran: The shipped defaults: confirmation OFF, first target 3.5R, 80% banked there, 4% risk, $4 minimum stop, both sessions, both directions, execution hours on.
_exercise_check: 10 trades, 22 armed bars. ⚠ Refusal codes 1, 5, 7 and 9 never fired, and FOUR features never ran at all — breakeven on an opposite shift, the time stop, the at-the-zone entry mode and the no-gap entry mode. The gate names every one of them on every run.
_fed_not_compared: ONLY the 1-minute confirmation stream. The 15-minute direction stream and both previous-period levels are now REBUILT from the export's own 5-minute bars and compared like everything else. A 1-minute stream cannot be rebuilt from a 5-minute chart, which is why it is the one thing left — and why moving the confirmation to 5 minutes would close the gate completely, on a new export.
